summary: Add a session-level unittest guard that fingerprints .agentic/**, docs/curiosity/**, and repo-root files before and after the suite and fails when tests leak into the checkout; CI runs via python -m tests.
migration_impact: Adopters copying ci.yml should run python -m tests (or keep unittest discover only if they opt out with PLATE_SKIP_CHECKOUT_ISOLATION=1).
agent_notes: Leaking tests are sandboxed with isolated_cwd (TemporaryDirectory + chdir). test_mcp_registry remains #1540 scope.
